svg.title: AFK alone, in test mode, from a real terminal session

g.text: The user pressed the AFK button in test mode. Start now.
This mode: Improve the tests: run the suite, add tests for what is uncovered, and repair
failing tests. Change production code only to fix a real bug a test exposed, and report each one.
- Do not commit, push, open pull requests, publish, deploy or message anyone.
- Ask no questions. Note a decision that is the user's, then take the reversible option.
